plan_scope: next 3 planting cycles (~one day with normal fertilizer use; ~28h48m with only 20% land acceleration and no fertilizer)
goal: leveling first; precompute all three rounds before touching the field; avoid any planned seed reaching zero
rules: Warehouse row-major order is the picker order; each warehouse row of five is one picker page.
Read full warehouse inventory once at the start of the daily 3-cycle batch.
During the three cycles, subtract only Agent-planned consumption from the saved snapshot; do not rescan warehouse each cycle.
If the user manually uses/receives seeds, a reward inserts a new visible seed, or an expected picker slot no longer matches, mark inventory dirty and refresh before further planting.
Every 4-plot seed must complete: select -> 2x2 preview -> explicit confirm -> verify landed. Never click another plot while preview is unconfirmed.
After one-key ordinary planting, verify all expected remaining cells are occupied.

postconditions_each_cycle: all planted seeds use 12-hour base maturity
all planted seeds use 12-hour base maturity

inventory_dirty_conditions: user manually plants or consumes any planned seed
daily/mission/activity reward adds a visible seed before a planned picker position
shop purchase changes planned seed quantity/order
picker page/slot does not match this plan
one-key planting result differs from the expected occupied-cell count
